remarks: Welcome to Phase Two at Mandolin Ridge, a new residential community comprising 56 lots across 47 acres, situated directly across from the Chautauqua Institution. This thoughtfully planned neighborhood offers a range of lots now being offered for sale as part of Phases One & Two. Create your custom home here with a variety of lots currently available. Corner and cul-de-sac lots available and are zoned for single-family homes. Secure your lot now and choose your builder!
